scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof with a separately replayable finite checker of the example and signed-incidence lemma; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite rational 2-by-2 matrix semigroups only; not a classification of all maximizers or a higher-dimensional optimum. Historical priority may be affected by unidentified earlier dimension-two work.
title: The sharp dimension-two bound for finite irreducible rational matrix semigroups
